# Kunal D Soni

> Software engineer. Builds payment systems by day (12 years across QA, release engineering, and product in the UAE, US, and India); this site is mostly about life - travel, food, and books.

- [Case study: BOTIM Ultra](https://kunaldsoni.github.io/case-botim.html): Remittance onboarding, cohort pricing, payout automation
- [Case study: Dopay](https://kunaldsoni.github.io/case-dopay.html): Payroll disbursement and card products for unbanked workers in MENA
- [Case study: Novo](https://kunaldsoni.github.io/case-novo.html): US SME digital banking - payment rails, onboarding automation, AML/fraud
- [Impact](https://kunaldsoni.github.io/impact.html): Results and startup advisory services
- [Life](https://kunaldsoni.github.io/life.html): Travel, food, and books
